decisions.reason: The camera rests directly on the firm's long optical and star-tracker heritage, so management can read mission feedback and refine the camera through its own R&D, and it still has a dedicated page.

The modular camera line fits the strategic shift toward compact, flexible sensors for small satellites, and its several models let the firm absorb customer learning across variants using existing optoelectronic know-how.

Space situational awareness is an adjacent, growing field where university and EU research cooperation supplies the related knowledge to improve the suite, though it carries more uncertainty than the core cameras.

The radiation-hard camera line is close to the firm's core radiation-tolerant optoelectronic competence and has just been launched with its own page, so early results are easy to interpret and act on.

Asteroid navigation builds on the firm's navigation camera know-how and fits its deep-space mission heritage, but its niche, mission-specific demand and mere mention on the website make it somewhat more vulnerable.
